title: Rezoning map change for 200 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision changing the zoning map from an M1-4 district to an M1-4A/R7X district and creating a Special Mixed Use District at 200 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. It would allow converting and expanding an existing five-story commercial building into a 14-story mixed-use development of about 135,500 square feet, including 143 residential units, 29-43 of them income-restricted, and 41,982 square feet of commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on the proposal on July 21, 2026.
